files.html:
Changelog 0.1.2

Currency Editor

  • Completely reworked the Currency Editor structure.
  • Added an option to choose whether designated items are automatically converted into currency.
  • Fixed multiple bugs related to the Currency Editor.

Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where NPC textures would break when editing NPCs that use player skin URLs.
  • Fixed missing item tooltip rendering in the NPC Shop Editor.
